registry.files.why: The registry's JSON files under /r: with the rest of the site they must stay under the Worker's 20,000 static files per version.

registry.bytes.why: The registry's JSON, total: it grows with items × combinations, about 19 MB expected at 64 components. Raised to 40 MB with P2-10's 70 charts, each an item for every React combination (8 styles × 2 bases): 1198 files, 8.0 MB in all; main measured 29.5 MB before the last 36. The Worker limits a file's size and the number of files (`registry.largest`, `registry.files`), not their total.

registry.largest.why: The largest registry file: the Worker serves no static file over 25 MiB.

demos.bytes.why: Each docs demo's code as a project writes it, the panels under the docs' previews (`r/demos`, the builder's `demos.ts`): one file per demo, its source per framework and base, and per icon library where it draws icons. 3.6 MB for 396 demos when added.

static.files.why: Every static file the Worker serves: its limit is 20,000 per version.
